The '''Sky Striker 5000''' was a model of [[sky slicer]] from [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. It was 2.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, could achieve 580 [[Kilometer/Legends|km]]/[[Standard hour/Legends|h]], and had a flight ceiling of 200 meters. It cost 3000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new&mdash;300 credits&mdash;600 credits used. An optional [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generator and drogue slicer were available for an additional 500 credits.
